correctness.rationale: For fixed Klein model over F5, smoothness follows nonzero Jacobian and Hessian H=x⁵z+xy⁵+yz⁵. Three coordinate flexes are transverse; on z=1, x≠0, elimination yields g(x)=x²¹+2x¹⁴+x⁷−1, factor degrees 3,6,6,6, each irreducible, with gcd(g,x¹⁴+1)=1. Independently checked polynomial identities and irreducibility and built exact degree-3/6 fields to evaluate tangent residual map tau. Computed tau³=id with no fixed flex, one rational coordinate triangle, one Frobenius-stable cubic triangle, six triangles permuted in one degree-six Frobenius orbit. Consequently 24 flex Frob cycle 1³3¹6³ and eight triangles 1²6¹, displayed extension counts and zetas. Field eliminations certify exhaustiveness (not empirical partial enumeration).
